program: Google Open Source Software VRP (OSS VRP) - Supply Chain

high_impact_vulnerability_classes.name: Pwn Request (pull_request_target + Untrusted Code Execution)
high_impact_vulnerability_classes.description: Workflow triggered by pull_request_target checks out untrusted PR head and runs scripts/build commands with write permissions or secrets.

high_impact_vulnerability_classes.name: Script / Expression Injection in Shell
high_impact_vulnerability_classes.description: Untrusted GitHub event context (e.g. pull_request.title, issue.body, head_ref, comment.body) interpolated directly inside a run: block.

high_impact_vulnerability_classes.name: Privileged workflow_run Artifact Poisoning
high_impact_vulnerability_classes.description: A privileged workflow_run workflow downloads artifacts uploaded by an unprivileged PR workflow and executes or sources them.

high_impact_vulnerability_classes.name: Public Fork Execution on Self-Hosted Runners
high_impact_vulnerability_classes.description: Workflow triggered by pull_request runs on self-hosted runners without authorization gating.
